package postgres

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestDeliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeProjectionIsSessionAndDeliveryFenced(t *testing.T) {
	for _, required := range []string{
		"handoff.planner_handoff_id=outcome.handoff_id",
		"handoff.student_id=outcome.student_id",
		"handoff.personal_teacher_id=outcome.personal_teacher_id",
		"handoff.dialog_id=outcome.dialog_id",
		"handoff.command_teacher_job_id=outcome.teacher_job_id",
		"outcome.student_id=$1",
		"outcome.personal_teacher_id=$2",
		"outcome.dialog_id=$3",
		"handoff.state_ref_kind=$4",
		"handoff.state_ref_version=$5",
		"outcome.status IN ('PATH_READY','ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS')",
		"outcome.dialog_message_id IS NOT NULL",
		"outcome.delivered_at IS NOT NULL",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, strings.ReplaceAll(deliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeForSessionSQL, " ", ""), strings.ReplaceAll(required, " ", ""))
	}
	require.NotContains(t, deliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeForSessionSQL, "course_id")
	require.NotContains(t, deliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeForSessionSQL, "learning_path_id")
	require.NotContains(t, deliveredTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeForSessionSQL, "first_lesson_id")
}

var fixedOutcomeTime = time.Date(2026, time.September, 11, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)

func TestConflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplayRejectsEventIDCollision(t *testing.T) {
	stored := testTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord()
	received := stored
	received.Outcome.EventID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"

	err := conflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplay(stored, received)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "execution_id is already bound to a different event_id")
}

func TestConflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplayRejectsDifferentEvidenceForSameEvent(t *testing.T) {
	stored := testTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord()
	received := stored
	received.Body = "different bounded body"

	err := conflictingTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeReplay(stored, received)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "event_id replay does not match immutable outcome evidence")
}

func testTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord() domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord {
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{
		Outcome: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{
			EventID:        "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			EventType:      domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject,
			CorrelationID:  "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			CausationID:    "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			StudentID:      "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			ExecutionID:    "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			HandoffID:      "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			DialogID:       "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			TeacherJobID:   "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
			Status:         domain.TeacherOnboardingPathReady,
			CourseID:       "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
			LearningPathID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
			FirstLessonID:  "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			OccurredAt:     fixedOutcomeTime,
		},
		PersonalTeacherID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
		Body:              "path ready",
		AcceptedAt:        fixedOutcomeTime,
	}
}
